title: Privacy Accounting for Empirical Denoisers
abstract: arXiv:2610.27710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as the foundation of modern generative systems, yet their high memorization capacity raises privacy concerns. While differentially private (DP) training provides formal guarantees, it comes at a cost in sample quality. In this work, we study a complementary question: how much privacy loss is incurred during the sampling process itself? Directly analyzing modern neural denoisers is challenging because their sensitivity to a single training example is generally intractable. To overcome this challenge, we construct and analyze a clipped privacy-accountable empirical denoiser, a training-free estimator of the Bayes-optimal denoiser, whose per-step sensitivity can be computed explicitly, allowing each denoising step to be a Gaussian mechanism. translated_title: 经验去噪器的隐私核算
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已成为现代生成系统的基础，但其强大的记忆能力引发了隐私方面的担忧。虽然差分隐私（DP）训练能够提供形式化的保证，但其代价是样本质量的下降。在本工作中，我们研究了一个与之互补的问题：在采样过程本身中会产生多少隐私损失？直接分析现代神经去噪器是具有挑战性的，因为它们对单个训练样本的敏感性通常是难以计算的。为了克服这一挑战，我们构建并分析了一种经过截断的隐私可问责经验去噪器——这是一种无需训练的贝叶斯最优去噪器估计器，其每一步的敏感性都可以被显式计算，从而使每个去噪步骤都能成为一个高斯机制。这一视角使得在以下情况下进行隐私核算成为可能：当每个训练样本对每个去噪步骤都有贡献时，可在高斯DP下进行隐私核算；当每个……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的截断隐私可问责经验去噪器，通过显式计算其每步敏感性，使扩散模型采样过程中的每一步去噪都可建模为高斯机制，从而实现对采样过程本身隐私损失的形式化核算。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a training-free clipped privacy-accountable empirical denoiser whose per-step sensitivity can be computed explicitly, turning each denoising step into a Gaussian mechanism and enabling formal privacy accounting of the diffusion sampling process itself.
